units.rawText: Ah, it's you, Professor. I thought I was imagining things when I saw you from the stage, but it turns out you actually came.

units.rawText: Your feelings have reached me, Professor. In the future, please feel free to look for us backstage. I want to share the joy of a successful show with you.
